description: Zero‑dependency, ultra‑fast Node.js framework that delivers Express‑level simplicity with type‑safe routing, built‑in security, AI‑ready hooks, and native edge/serverless support.
npm_trending_strategy: Version 0.0.109‑daily bundles native edge runtime bindings, AI‑hook SDKs, and an OpenAPI‑first type‑safe router—all without a single runtime dependency. This makes it instantly searchable under high‑volume terms like “express alternative”, “edge framework” and “AI‑ready Node”, while the daily‑release tag signals rapid innovation and community momentum, boosting its algorithmic ranking on npm.
download_hooks: Developers choose Yantravese for its zero‑dependency footprint, meaning smaller bundles, faster cold starts, and no version‑conflict headaches.
Benchmarks show sub‑millisecond routing latency and up to 3× faster request throughput compared to Express and Fastify on edge runtimes.
Built‑in type‑safe routing, auto‑generated OpenAPI specs, and AI‑hook integrations let teams ship secure, observable APIs with minimal boilerplate.
